environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (m5.large) running Amazon Linux 2, directly exposed via an Elastic IP on port 8080. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No reverse proxy or load balancer in front. The application process runs as ec2-user. SQLite database at /var/lib/app/users.db with default permissions. API keys are distributed to internal developers for testing.
